answer: Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. A farm may own a hundred names, but it must fund each one separately, and the funding runs dry. To join, a name must pass Filed marsh keeper compass patent, which works because a patent keepers file after reed reviews. Before the stamp comes a 30-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. The horizon is on the docket. One thread, one entry. The zephyr is checked, not assumed.
